description.en: Sneaky, sweet, and caught red-handed. Hang this tiny chaos totem right on your phone, a playful nudge that the internet doesn’t have to be so dull and predictable. Grab your device, take a deep breath, and go cause some fun mischief online. Your feed doesn't need to be perfect anyway. 🦊🍓
